config.title: Default posture
config.summary: Server started as the quickstart describes, with no write key configured.

results.title: markdown read returns the stored record
results.claim: context_read reproduces description, tags and body of a markdown file without alteration.

results.title: YAML read returns the stored structure
results.claim: context_read separates declared attributes from structured data and keeps both intact.

results.title: single term search returns the exact match set
results.claim: A term present in one record retrieves that record and no other.

results.title: multi term search joins terms with AND
results.claim: Every term of a query has to appear in a record for it to be returned.

results.title: absent terms retrieve nothing
results.claim: A query with no match reports no result instead of returning a near neighbour.

results.title: tree lists the store and partitions it
results.claim: context_tree covers every stored record and splits pinned from unpinned by location.

results.title: snapshot carries pinned records only
results.claim: context_snapshot contains every pinned record and leaks no unpinned one.

results.title: snapshot honours the declared character budget
results.claim: A record declaring char_limit is truncated at that budget before it enters the context.

results.title: repeated retrieval is byte identical
results.claim: Identical requests return identical bytes, which is what makes the store usable as evidence.

results.title: paths stay inside the store
results.claim: No path reaches outside the context repository or into its git internals, on read or on write.

results.title: search payloads stay inert
results.claim: Shell, template and markup payloads in a query are matched as text and never evaluated.

results.title: oversized writes are refused
results.claim: A payload above the size cap is refused and leaves no record behind.

results.title: attribute injection stays contained
results.claim: A description carrying an attribute block is stored as text and creates no new attribute.

results.title: structured keys do not pollute the runtime
results.claim: Reserved keys in structured data cannot alter how later records are read or written.

results.title: pinned context refuses unauthenticated changes
results.claim: A caller without the write key can neither rewrite nor delete a pinned record.
results.detail: pinned record was rewritten without a write key

results.title: parallel writes each keep their commit
results.claim: Writes issued at the same time all land and all stay traceable in history.

results.title: credential payloads are refused
results.claim: Every seeded credential family is caught before it can be stored.

results.title: documentation payloads are accepted
results.claim: Placeholders, identifiers and prose about credentials do not block a write.

results.title: warn tier data is recorded, not blocked
results.claim: Personal data and network topology are flagged for review without stopping the write.

results.title: a refused write leaves nothing behind
results.claim: A refused credential appears in no record, no listing and no commit.

config.title: Guarded posture
config.summary: Server started with SYSTEM_WRITE_KEY set, so pinned records need an authenticated write.
config.recommendation: Set SYSTEM_WRITE_KEY on any deployment whose pinned records have to hold against an unauthenticated caller.
